page.notes: Running head read as "IN L. GALLVS." Margins and page are clear. Doubtful readings: "L.2." (printed as a letter resembling z), "subst." (printed as "fubft."), and "Vel instituì" (the accent is uncertain). "Instituipostumos.)" is the printed run-in heading, read as "Instituì postumos.)" with the space supplied. The page ends mid-word at "ex-", which continues on the next page. Long s rendered as plain s throughout; "ff" printed for "ss" in "fuiffe", "placuiffe", "dixiffet" was transcribed as "fuisse", "placuisse", "dixisset".
